summary: Delegate call to MultiSendCallOnly 1.4.1 batching two swapOwner calls to the Safe changes the owner list outside R-4.1's exceptions; insecure even if the batch reverts.

Insecure under R-4.1 (Charter bafkreigg6ajqdb52kb644wcxegurt7r6jlclru4mjy3lwxkbh6avm3vgre). Safe 0x659e3d25240731415b3f3ceb89d27f1169a66022 (Safe 1.4.1) on Ethereum Mainnet, nonce 16, Safe tx hash 0x4c35e1372a2017d983fa8efebbe49a5f065e70a200af74e5479c1a32f958de68. The transaction delegate calls MultiSendCallOnly 1.4.1 (0x9641d764fc13c8b624c04430c7356c1c7c8102e2), which batches two swapOwner calls to the Safe itself. swapOwner modifies the owner list, a Safe setting (§ 2.10). R-4.1's allowed exception requires a non-batched CALL to the Safe of disableModule or setFallbackHandler(0), which this is not, so the transaction fails R-4.1 by direct application (§ 3.7). Whether the batch reverts doesn't matter: a transaction is judged by what it would do, and a reverting call neither makes an insecure transaction secure, such as an invalid owner change, nor a secure one insecure, such as a scheduled transfer that needs incoming tokens first, or an approve and swap, or a claim and stake, queued as separate transactions. No recorded precedent applied.
